Performance & Analytics Exploration (v0.1.0)

• High-level summary KPI metrics: overall accuracy, volume, completed mock exams, average solving pace.
• Breakdown by subject with visual progress bars.
• Distinct separation of ordinary practice accuracy vs. timed mock exam performance under time pressure.
• Weak topic identification providing clear direction for focused revision.
• Comprehensive audit log of past study sessions and full mock simulations with direct review action.
